steps.title: Music and screen text
steps.body: audio.setMusic(music) changes the music (audio.stopMusic() stops it). screen.setText(screen, element, text) changes a text on a screen — the HUD's message line here. screen.show / screen.hide open and close whole screens.
steps.task: Set the music and the HUD message in the start block.

steps.title: Play a scene
steps.body: cinematic.play(scene, once) plays a cinematic (once: only the first time). on("cinematicDone", …) runs when it ends — a good moment for the next part of the story.
steps.task: Play the reward scene when rich, and react when it ends.
